map.频率分辨率 Δf = 采样率 fs ÷ FFT 长度 N；奈奎斯特频率 = fs: Frequency resolution Δf = sample rate fs ÷ FFT length N; Nyquist frequency = fs ÷ 2; the frequency of bin k = k×Δf. This page does not capture audio, run an FFT or draw a spectrum plot - it only converts these parameters to help you read results from an external spectrum analyzer. Everything is computed locally in the browser; no data is uploaded.

map.窗函数选型：了解汉宁窗主瓣展宽（约 2 个 bin），避免相邻频率被主瓣掩盖而误: Window selection: understand that the Hann window widens the main lobe (about 2 bins), so adjacent frequencies are not masked by the main lobe and misread.
map.频率分辨率 Δf=fs/N=8000/1024=7.8125 Hz；奈奎斯特频率: Frequency resolution Δf=fs/N=8000/1024=7.8125 Hz; Nyquist frequency=fs/2=4000 Hz; the target bin 10 corresponds to 10×7.8125=78.125 Hz; Hann main lobe width=2×Δf=15.625 Hz. The tool computes directly from the formula to help read spectrum values and locate peaks.
map.频率分辨率太低怎么办？: What if the frequency resolution is too coarse?
map.提高 FFT 长度 N 或降低采样率（需仍满足奈奎斯特）可提高 Δf 的细度；但: Increasing the FFT length N or lowering the sample rate (while still meeting Nyquist) refines Δf; but a very large N raises computation cost, and note that the window main lobe widens accordingly.
map.怎样避免频谱混叠？: How do I avoid spectral aliasing?
map.采样率必须高于目标最高频率的两倍（奈奎斯特），否则高频成分会折叠到低频造成混叠；: The sample rate must be more than twice the highest frequency of interest (Nyquist), otherwise high-frequency content folds back into low frequencies and causes aliasing; apply an anti-aliasing filter before sampling when necessary.
